versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Social Sentiment Monitor skill.
- Real-time monitoring of crypto discussions across Twitter, Reddit, Telegram, and Discord.
- Supports analysis of community sentiment, hot topic tracking, KOL monitoring, and viral content discovery.
- Provides FUD/negative sentiment alerts and auto-generates sentiment/trend reports.
- Integrates with SkillPay, charging 0.01 USDT per use via BNB Chain.

Version 1.0.1 of shenmeng-social-sentiment-monitor

- No changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, configuration, and documentation remain unchanged.
- This update is intended to maintain versioning consistency.

Initial release – 社交媒体舆情监控助手，上线 1.0.0 版本。

- 实时监控 Twitter、Reddit、Telegram、Discord 等平台的加密货币讨论与情绪分析
- 自动追踪热点话题、KOL发言、负面舆情（FUD）和病毒式内容
- 多种情绪指标（看涨/看跌/恐慌/FOMO）和综合报告生成
- 支持关键词、KOL和多平台自定义监控，支持付费 SkillPay 调用
- 提供丰富脚本与配置，集成主流社交与链上数据源
- 支持自动预警、通知及详细情绪/讨论热度评分
